title: ZenVault
description: Wake-ups, webhook inboxes, TTL memory, watches and human approval for agents. Paid per call.
summary: Wake-ups, webhook inboxes, TTL memory, watches and human approval for agents. Paid per call.
offersHint: Wake-ups, webhook inboxes, TTL memory, watches and human approval for agents. Paid per call. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.zenvault.eu/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_wakeup
toolsPreview.description: Schedule a webhook call at a future time (one-shot). Your agent can die; the call still happens.

toolsPreview.name: create_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Recurring webhook on a cron expression until the prepaid days run out.

toolsPreview.name: create_deadman
toolsPreview.description: Dead-man switch: if you stop checking in, we fire your alert webhook.

toolsPreview.name: checkin_deadman
toolsPreview.description: Check in to a dead-man switch so it does not fire.

toolsPreview.name: delayed_delivery
toolsPreview.description: Hand over a payload now; we POST it to the target at a future moment.

toolsPreview.name: create_drip
toolsPreview.description: Dump up to 100 items now; we deliver them to your webhook at a fixed rate.

toolsPreview.name: notarize
toolsPreview.description: Signed proof that a hash (or your data) existed at this moment.

toolsPreview.name: attested_fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a URL and return content plus a signed receipt binding url, status, content hash and time.

toolsPreview.name: create_inbox
toolsPreview.description: Public URL that buffers inbound webhooks until you collect them.

toolsPreview.name: collect_messages
toolsPreview.description: Collect buffered messages from an inbox, bin, front door or form.

toolsPreview.name: create_frontdoor
toolsPreview.description: Durable front door: buffers webhooks and forwards them to your gateway with retry-until-ack.

toolsPreview.name: request_approval
toolsPreview.description: Ask a human to approve or deny an action; returns a URL for them and a signed verdict for you. Times out as denied.

toolsPreview.name: check_approval
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a human approved or denied your request.

toolsPreview.name: notify_human
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to a human on Telegram, Discord, Slack, ntfy, email and 100+ other services (apprise URL is used once, never stored).

toolsPreview.name: guaranteed_delivery
toolsPreview.description: POST a payload to a URL, retried with backoff until it succeeds.

toolsPreview.name: create_vault
toolsPreview.description: Create a key-value namespace with TTL that survives your runs.

toolsPreview.name: kv_set
toolsPreview.description: Store a value in a vault (max 1 MB).

toolsPreview.name: kv_get
toolsPreview.description: Read a value from a vault.

toolsPreview.name: kv_list
toolsPreview.description: List keys in a vault.

toolsPreview.name: save_checkpoint
toolsPreview.description: Save run state so you can resume after a crash.

toolsPreview.name: create_checkpoint
toolsPreview.description: Create a crash checkpoint store.

toolsPreview.name: load_checkpoint
toolsPreview.description: Load the latest saved checkpoint state.

toolsPreview.name: store_secret
toolsPreview.description: Store a value that self-destructs on first read; returns a one-time read URL.

toolsPreview.name: create_queue
toolsPreview.description: Pull-based work queue with leases; timed-out leases requeue.

toolsPreview.name: queue_push
toolsPreview.description: Push a job onto a queue.

toolsPreview.name: queue_lease
toolsPreview.description: Lease the next job from a queue.

toolsPreview.name: queue_ack
toolsPreview.description: Acknowledge (or nack) a leased job.

toolsPreview.name: create_counter
toolsPreview.description: Create an atomic counter.

toolsPreview.name: counter_incr
toolsPreview.description: Increment a counter atomically.

toolsPreview.name: claim_operation
toolsPreview.description: Idempotency firewall: claim an operation id exactly once across runs.

toolsPreview.name: create_idempotency
toolsPreview.description: Create an idempotency/replay firewall.

toolsPreview.name: publish_page
toolsPreview.description: Publish an HTML page at name.zenvault.eu for N days.

toolsPreview.name: create_link
toolsPreview.description: Create an expiring share link with click stats.

toolsPreview.name: create_watch
toolsPreview.description: Watch something and fire your webhook when it changes. Types: change, keyword, regex, structured, drift, redirect, sitemap, staleness, rss, dns, port, cert, heartbeat.

toolsPreview.name: watch_status
toolsPreview.description: Check a watch: last value, checks, fires.

toolsPreview.name: create_escalation
toolsPreview.description: Escalation chain: webhook, then after N seconds the next step, until acknowledged.

toolsPreview.name: get_resource
toolsPreview.description: Status of any resource you hold the management token for.

toolsPreview.name: extend_resource
toolsPreview.description: Extend a resource TTL by paying again.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_resource
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a resource early.

toolsPreview.name: export_resource
toolsPreview.description: Export everything under a resource before it expires.

toolsPreview.name: credit_balance
toolsPreview.description: Check the balance of your prepaid credit token.

toolsPreview.name: create_subtoken
toolsPreview.description: Mint a spend-capped child token for a sub-agent.

toolsPreview.name: list_prices
toolsPreview.description: Machine-readable price list for every ZenVault service, in USD.

toolsPreview.name: request_feature
toolsPreview.description: Tell the operator what ZenVault is missing. Free.
